integrity: Finite exhaustive Python computations with a complete graph/clique reduction and independent crosschecks. No independent external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only binary codes of cardinality eight, cyclic read-pair windows, distance n-1; exhaustive finite classification for n=3..7, not for different sizes or read widths. Prior linear isomorphism class, code existence and one length-six count are acknowledged.
title: Affine rigidity of binary eight-word maximum-distance symbol-pair codes
